about.title: About
paragraphs: On Saturday 7 November 2026, Bernie Grant Arts Centre hosts DARÉ: A Live Encounter with Sound, an immersive, multisensory performance by Zimbabwean-born artist Shumba Maasai. Doors at 7pm, the performance from 8:30pm to 10pm.

Rooted in the Shona concept of the daré, a traditional gathering space for communal wisdom and healing, the work brings ancient African practices into the contemporary art sphere, exploring the ties between the African diaspora and its roots.

Weaving together live performance, spatial audio, scent design and immersive visuals, DARÉ on stage is a sonic portrait and a fully immersive theatre show for all audiences. After eleven days as an installation at Zimbabwe House in October, this is where it goes next, for one night only. Presented by Ancestral Futures in partnership with Bernie Grant Arts Centre.
statement: A gathering of memory, feeling and imagination.
